lite_mode.title: Lite Mode
lite_mode.brief: Lite mode reduces overheating and power consumption during gameplay by lowering CPU and component frequencies. This setting applies to all games when enabled.

disable_tweaks.title: Disable Tweaks
disable_tweaks.brief: When enabled, this setting turns off all built-in performance optimizations on Encore Tweaks, allowing you to use this module strictly as a host for Encore Addon modules.

device_mitigation.title: Device Mitigation
device_mitigation.brief: Device mitigation disables potentially incompatible tweaks for specific devices. Keep it disabled unless you have problems.

fas.title: Frame Aware Scheduling
fas.per_game_hint: FAS is enabled per game. Open a game in the Games tab and turn on Frame Aware Scheduling. The settings below apply to every game that uses FAS.
fas.brief: FAS watches every frame the game renders and sets the CPU frequency so the game just barely holds its frame rate. It aims slightly below the target: while frames come in faster than that, frequency drops a little each frame, and as soon as frames run late it goes back up. Clusters running the game's busiest threads are locked to that frequency, the rest are capped. Requires the encore_fas kernel module.
fas.min_freq_brief: Lowest frequency FAS may set, as a percentage of the fastest core. Raise it if a game stutters when scenes suddenly get heavy.
fas.margin_brief: How many fps (per 60) below the target FAS aims for. Higher saves more power but may cost a frame now and then; 0 holds the target as tightly as possible.
fas.thermal_brief: When the CPU gets hotter than this, FAS gradually lowers the target frame rate to cool down.

undervolt.title: Undervolt
undervolt.unsupported: Your kernel does not expose the Exynos voltage margin interface (/sys/kernel/percent_margin).
undervolt.warning: Undervolting lowers voltage below what Samsung validated for your chip. Too much causes app crashes, freezes or random reboots. Go down 1% at a time and test with games or benchmarks before going further.
undervolt.safety: Boot loop protection: new values must survive 2 minutes. If the device reboots before that, Encore resets undervolt to stock on the next boot.
undervolt.pending: Testing stability, keep the device running for 2 minutes
undervolt.last_unstable_hint: The device rebooted while testing these values, so Encore reset undervolt to stock. Try smaller steps, starting with the domain you changed last.
undervolt.brief: Values are a percentage of each voltage level, applied live through Samsung's ACPM firmware. Setting a domain back to 0% unsets the margin; reboot to fully restore stock voltages.
